faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Longcat Avatar

q1.question: What is Longcat Avatar?
q1.answer: Longcat Avatar is an advanced AI-powered avatar video generator that creates synchronized talking avatar videos from audio and image inputs. Longcat Avatar uses cutting-edge AI technology to generate realistic lip-sync and facial expressions, making it the perfect tool for creating professional avatar videos.

q2.question: What audio formats does Longcat Avatar support?
q2.answer: Longcat Avatar supports all common audio formats including MP3, WAV, M4A, and other standard audio formats. With Longcat Avatar, you can create avatar videos from audio files up to 2 minutes long.

q3.question: What image formats can I use with Longcat Avatar?
q3.answer: Longcat Avatar accepts any standard image format including JPG, PNG, WEBP, and more. For the best Longcat Avatar results, we recommend using clear, front-facing portrait photos with good lighting.

q4.question: What video resolutions does Longcat Avatar support?
q4.answer: Longcat Avatar offers two resolution options: 480p (standard) and 720p (HD). Choose the resolution that fits your needs. Higher resolution Longcat Avatar videos require more credits but deliver superior quality.

q5.question: How long can Longcat Avatar videos be?
q5.answer: Longcat Avatar can generate avatar videos up to 2 minutes (120 seconds) long. Longcat Avatar calculates credits in 5-second blocks, ensuring fair and transparent pricing for your avatar video projects.

q6.question: How does Longcat Avatar create lip-sync?
q6.answer: Longcat Avatar uses advanced AI technology to analyze your audio and automatically synchronize lip movements and facial expressions. Longcat Avatar ensures natural, realistic animations that match your audio perfectly.

q7.question: Is Longcat Avatar free to use?
q7.answer: Longcat Avatar offers flexible pricing with credits. You can try Longcat Avatar and see the quality for yourself. Check our pricing page for detailed Longcat Avatar credit packages and plans.
